= Mathematics

Inline mathematics is written with `stem:[...]`.

The notation is literal:

stem:[E = mc^2]

stem:[a_1 * b_2]

The underscore and asterisk stay in the notation. They are not parsed as inline
markup.

A mathematics block uses `++++` delimiters:

++++
\sum_{i=1}^n i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
++++

The `[stem]` attribute can also be written.

It has the same meaning as a bare `++++` delimiter:

[stem]
++++
e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0
++++

A passthrough block sends its contents to the output unchanged:

[pass]
++++
<aside class="hand-written">Markup cl-adoc did not generate.</aside>
++++

Other text is still escaped during rendering.

For example, a < b stays readable.
